evals.prompt: Create a Python FastAPI endpoint at /health that returns JSON {"status": "ok"}. Write a pytest test that calls the endpoint and asserts the response status is 200 and the body matches. Run the test and show the output.
evals.expected_output: A FastAPI app with /health endpoint and a passing pytest test

assertions.name: fastapi_app_exists
assertions.description: A Python file containing FastAPI app creation exists

assertions.name: tests_pass
assertions.description: pytest output shows at least one passing test

assertions.name: health_endpoint_returns_ok
assertions.description: The /health endpoint returns JSON with status 'ok'

assertions.name: uses_tdd
assertions.description: Test file was created before or alongside the implementation file

evals.prompt: Write a reversible Alembic-style SQL migration (using raw SQL in a Python file) that adds a UNIQUE index on the email column of an existing users table. Include a downgrade that drops the index. The migration should be idempotent.
evals.expected_output: A Python migration script with upgrade and downgrade functions using raw SQL

assertions.name: has_upgrade
assertions.description: Migration contains an upgrade function or method

assertions.name: has_downgrade
assertions.description: Migration contains a downgrade function or method

assertions.name: uses_raw_sql
assertions.description: Migration uses raw SQL strings, not ORM abstractions

assertions.name: idempotent_check
assertions.description: Migration includes IF NOT EXISTS or similar idempotency guard
